title: The Effectiveness of Carbon Pricing: A Global Evaluation
title_zh: 碳定价的有效性：全球评估
title_primary: 碳定价的有效性：全球评估
title_secondary: The Effectiveness of Carbon Pricing: A Global Evaluation
authors: Sen, Suphi, Sadikoglu, Serhan, Ji, Changjing, van der Werf, Edwin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the effect of the staggered adoption of carbon pricing policies across the globe between 1990 and 2017 on per capita $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions from fossil fuel combustion. We use recent econometric techniques robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. Our dynamic treatment effect estimations indicate gradual adjustments after implementation, resulting in a 19 to 23 percent decrease in $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions after 10 years. These effects were primarily driven by resource substitution rather than improvements in energy efficiency and were not driven by short-term responses to carbon prices. Our results are robust to controlling for the potential effects of renewable energy policies. These results highlight the role of carbon pricing policies in steering medium-term expectations and complementing the climate policy mix.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了1990年至2017年间全球范围内碳定价政策分阶段实施对化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳人均排放量的影响。我们采用了近期对处理效应异质性稳健的计量经济学技术。动态处理效应估计显示，政策实施后调整逐步进行，十年后二氧化碳排放量下降了19%至23%。这些效应主要源于资源替代，而非能源效率的提升，并且并非由对碳价格的短期反应所驱动。我们的结果在控制可再生能源政策潜在影响后依然稳健。这些发现凸显了碳定价政策在引导中期预期及补充气候政策组合中的作用。

title: Beliefs about Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
title_zh: 关于政府债务估值与可持续性的信念
title_primary: 关于政府债务估值与可持续性的信念
title_secondary: Beliefs about Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
authors: Ricardo Delao, Wenhao Li
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What ultimately supports the market value of U.S. government debt? We measure valuation frameworks: the perceived channels that back debt value. We survey bond investors, registered voters, and economics or finance graduate-degree holders, asking them to allocate debt value across six sources derived from open-ended answers and the literature. Global safe-asset demand and permanent rollover together account for almost half of perceived value in every group, so debt value heavily relies on investor absorption rather than on government resources. Future primary surpluses, the textbook debt backing, receive about 16% even among the graduate-trained; roughly one-third say they provide little or no support. Allocations concentrate within respondents but disperse across them, forming belief archetypes that vary little with fiscal knowledge. A model shows why belief elicitation matters: identical debt quantities and price schedules can conceal differences in saleable public backing and stress-resilient demand, and therefore in debt sustainability. Concern about debt sustainability is widespread, and all three groups put the ten-year crisis odds near 50%. However, among respondents expressing concern, 90% of voters report that it is not decisive in their voting decisions, and 72% of investors report no concrete portfolio change.
abstract_zh: 最终支撑美国政府债务市场价值的是什么？我们衡量了估值框架：即支撑债务价值的感知渠道。我们调查了债券投资者、登记选民以及经济学或金融学研究生学历持有者，要求他们将债务价值分配至六个来源，这些来源源自开放式回答和文献。全球安全资产需求与永久性展期在每个群体中合计约占感知价值的一半，因此债务价值在很大程度上依赖于投资者的吸收能力，而非政府资源。未来基本盈余——教科书式的债务支撑——即使在受过研究生教育的群体中也仅获得约16%的权重；约三分之一的人表示其提供很少或没有支持。分配在受访者内部集中，但在受访者之间分散，形成了信念原型，这些原型随财政知识的变化甚微。一个模型揭示了为何信念引出至关重要：相同的债务数量和价格表可能掩盖可出售公共支撑和抗压力需求方面的差异，从而掩盖债务可持续性方面的差异。对债务可持续性的担忧普遍存在，且所有三个群体给出的十年危机概率均接近50%。然而，在表达担忧的受访者中，90%的选民表示这在其投票决策中并非决定性因素，72%的投资者表示未采取具体的投资组合调整。

title: The Deeper Roots of Human Capital Formation and Economic Development in Southeast Asia, 1900 – 2000
title_zh: 1900—2000年东南亚人力资本形成与经济发展的深层根源
title_primary: 1900—2000年东南亚人力资本形成与经济发展的深层根源
title_secondary: The Deeper Roots of Human Capital Formation and Economic Development in Southeast Asia, 1900 – 2000
authors: Alexandra de Pleijt, Ewout Frankema
official: 官方在线 2025-03-25 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores the 20th century schooling revolution as one of the deeper roots of this major leap in human prosperity. Using micro-data on the educational attainment and migration status of ca. 123 million individuals, subdivided across 277 provinces in eight Southeast Asian countries, we establish a strong and significant relationship between early educational attainment and sub-national economic development at the start of the 21st century. Using a wide range of historical and geographic controls, we find that higher education shares are more strongly associated with regional development outcomes than mass education. We also find a strong and robust contribution of inter-regional and international migration to human capital accumulation and long-term development.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了20世纪教育革命作为人类繁荣重大飞跃的深层根源之一。利用涵盖约1.23亿个体教育程度与迁移状况的微观数据，这些数据细分至八个东南亚国家的277个省份，我们确立了早期教育程度与21世纪初次国家层面经济发展之间强烈且显著的关系。通过采用广泛的历史与地理控制变量，我们发现高等教育比例与区域发展成果的关联强于大众教育。同时，我们还发现区域间及国际迁移对人力资本积累和长期发展具有强劲且稳健的贡献。

title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
title_zh: 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的职业流动性
title_primary: 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的职业流动性
title_secondary: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
authors: Alex Clymo, Piotr Denderski, Yusuf Mercan, Benjamin Schoefer
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
abstract_zh: 工作流动性具有风险，工人是风险规避的，且保险市场不完善。本文研究这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间转换：他们过分重视工作安全性，而轻视工资和生产率收益。我们通过一项定制、具有代表性的调查，引出在职工人的工资-安全性无差异曲线，从而展示这一权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求每增加一个百分点的年度失业风险，需获得1.63%的加薪才愿意接受新工作。我们通过将该机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作不仅在工资（生产率）上存在差异，也在失业风险上有所不同，风险规避的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险，同时在职或离职状态下进行搜索。我们发现，一个完全市场的反事实情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险高但生产率高的职位，从而提高生产率（提高1.3%）和职位创造——同时也增加了失业和失业率。

title: Price caps, commitment and innovation
title_zh: 价格上限、承诺与创新
title_primary: 价格上限、承诺与创新
title_secondary: Price caps, commitment and innovation
authors: Gamal Atallah, Aggey Simons (Semenov)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze innovation incentives under price‐cap regulation by examining scenarios with endogenous price caps, both with and without regulatory commitment. In a setting without informational imperfections, our analysis reveals two principal conclusions. First, there is no trade‐off between static and dynamic efficiency. Strengthening firm incentives by allowing it to charge higher prices, and thus realize greater profits, leads to less innovation because it reduces output. The optimal strategy to boost innovation and maximize welfare is to set a low price (and thus, a low profit) target because innovation incentives are proportional to output. Second, the benefits of regulatory commitment for innovation and welfare are not unambiguously clear: commitment neither consistently outperforms nor underperforms non‐commitment. Under demand uncertainty, when the firm is risk‐averse, the static–dynamic efficiency trade‐off reappears, and the firm may prefer non‐commitment due to risk‐shielding. Under asymmetric information about firm demand type, the trade‐off between static and dynamic efficiency becomes inherent (due to information rents and contract distortions), and commitment becomes unambiguously crucial for fostering innovation by preventing the “ratchet effect.”
abstract_zh: 我们分析了价格上限监管下的创新激励，通过考察内生价格上限的情景，既包括有监管承诺也包括无监管承诺的情况。在无信息不完全的设定下，我们的分析揭示了两个主要结论。第一，静态效率与动态效率之间不存在权衡。通过允许企业设定更高价格从而获得更大利润来增强企业激励，反而会因产出减少而导致创新降低。促进创新并最大化福利的最优策略是设定较低的价格（因此利润目标也较低），因为创新激励与产出成正比。第二，监管承诺对创新和福利的益处并非明确无疑：承诺既非始终优于也非始终劣于不承诺。在需求不确定性下，当企业风险规避时，静态与动态效率的权衡重新出现，且企业可能因风险规避而偏好不承诺。在企业需求类型信息不对称的情况下，静态与动态效率之间的权衡变得固有（源于信息租金和合同扭曲），而承诺对于通过防止“棘轮效应”来促进创新变得明确至关重要。

title: Can heritage protection promote local consumption? Evidence from National Key Cultural Relics protection Units in China
title_zh: 遗产保护能否促进本地消费？来自中国全国重点文物保护单位的证据
title_primary: 遗产保护能否促进本地消费？来自中国全国重点文物保护单位的证据
title_secondary: Can heritage protection promote local consumption? Evidence from National Key Cultural Relics protection Units in China
authors: Baocheng Zhao, Wenlong Ren, Shaohui Zhang, Yongze Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Whether cultural heritage protection can preserve historical and cultural resources while expanding county-level consumption market activity is important for understanding the economic effects of cultural policy. Using county-level panel data from China for 2000–2019, this paper exploits the staggered designation of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units and applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach. The results show that heritage protection significantly increases county-level retail-based consumption activity, and the finding remains robust across multiple checks. Mechanism analysis shows that local fiscal expenditure, infrastructure investment, fixed-asset investment, service-sector expansion, tourist flows, service-sector employment, and land-value capitalization change in directions consistent with the theoretical predictions. These results suggest that heritage protection may expand county-level consumption market activity through supply-side improvements and demand-side expansion, including tourist spending and broader local market responses. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effect is mainly concentrated in counties in central and western China, non-core administrative counties, and smaller counties. This paper provides evidence on the local market effects of cultural heritage protection and offers policy implications for activating cultural resources in less developed areas.
abstract_zh: 文化遗产保护能否在保存历史文化资源的同时扩大县域消费市场活力，对于理解文化政策的经济效应具有重要意义。本文利用2000-2019年中国县域面板数据，基于全国重点文物保护单位的分批认定政策，采用交错双重差分法进行实证分析。研究结果表明，文化遗产保护显著提升了县域零售消费活力，该结论在多项稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析显示，地方财政支出、基础设施投资、固定资产投资、服务业扩张、旅游客流、服务业就业及土地价值资本化等指标的变化方向均与理论预期一致。这些发现表明，文化遗产保护可能通过供给侧改善与需求侧扩张（包括旅游消费及更广泛的地方市场响应）来扩大县域消费市场活力。异质性分析显示，该效应主要集中在中西部地区、非核心行政县及规模较小的县域。本文为文化遗产保护的本地市场效应提供了实证证据，并为激活欠发达地区文化资源提供了政策启示。

title: Price Transmission Dynamics in Ghana fs Rice Market: Spatial and Macroeconomic Analysis
title_zh: 加纳大米市场价格传导动态：空间与宏观经济分析
title_primary: 加纳大米市场价格传导动态：空间与宏观经济分析
title_secondary: Price Transmission Dynamics in Ghana fs Rice Market: Spatial and Macroeconomic Analysis
authors: Seth Ampomah Duodu (International University of Japan), Norio Usui (International University of Japan)
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With soaring domestic demand, Ghana has become highly dependent on imported rice, thereby tying domestic rice prices more closely to international prices. This study aims to analyze how international and domestic rice prices interact, as well as how imported prices affect domestic prices across regions. This study applies the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model to analyze the long-run relationships and short-run dynamics of imported prices, domestic prices, world prices, and overall inflation. The data used are monthly data from ten major rice markets in Ghana for the period 2012 to 2024. The results indicate a long-run relationship between imported and domestic rice prices, and some degree of integration with the global market. Price transmission is faster in coastal markets but slower in the north, where shocks can take more than a year to be reflected in local prices. Ineffective policies, poor infrastructure, and macroeconomic instability explain why Ghana is largely a price taker. This study clarifies region-specific cross-market price transmission, identifying a clear south-north transmission gradient and slower adjustment speeds compared to those found in previous studies.
abstract_zh: 随着国内需求激增，加纳对进口大米的依赖程度显著提高，国内大米价格与国际价格的关联性也随之增强。本研究旨在分析国际与国内大米价格之间的互动机制，以及进口价格如何影响各地区国内价格。研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，分析进口价格、国内价格、世界价格及整体通胀之间的长期关系与短期动态。数据涵盖2012年至2024年加纳十大主要大米市场的月度数据。结果表明，进口大米价格与国内大米价格存在长期关系，且与全球市场存在一定程度的整合。沿海市场的价格传导速度较快，而北部地区则较慢，冲击可能需要一年以上才能反映在当地价格中。政策失效、基础设施薄弱及宏观经济不稳定解释了加纳为何在很大程度上是价格接受者。本研究厘清了特定区域的跨市场价格传导机制，识别出明显的南-北传导梯度，且调整速度较以往研究更慢。

title: Warming with Borders: Forced Climate Migration and Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 带有边界的变暖：被迫气候迁移与碳定价
title_primary: 带有边界的变暖：被迫气候迁移与碳定价
title_secondary: Warming with Borders: Forced Climate Migration and Carbon Pricing
authors: Alsina-Pujols, Maria
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As climate changes and natural disasters intensify, the threat of human displacement increases. This paper studies carbon taxation in the presence of international climate displacement. After providing evidence on the migration response to disasters, forced climate migration is introduced into a quantitative climatemacroeconomic model to theoretically characterize the global and local social costs of carbon—SCCs, equivalently, optimal carbon taxes. These change substantially when this type of migration is considered. A North-South calibration reveals that, while migration increases the local SCC in host regions—more so if political conflict is considered—the origin region and global SCCs are not much affected.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化与自然灾害加剧，人类流离失所的威胁日益增加。本文研究了存在国际气候移民情况下的碳税问题。在提供灾害移民响应证据后，将强迫性气候移民引入量化气候宏观经济模型，从理论上刻画全球与地方碳的社会成本（SCCs），即最优碳税。当考虑此类移民时，这些成本发生显著变化。南北校准结果显示，虽然移民提高了接收地区的本地SCC（若考虑政治冲突则影响更大），但来源地区与全球SCC并未受到显著影响。

title: Market connectedness and price spillovers in Ghanaian maize and yam markets: Implications for food security
title_zh: 加纳玉米与山药市场的市场关联性与价格溢出效应：对粮食安全的启示
title_primary: 加纳玉米与山药市场的市场关联性与价格溢出效应：对粮食安全的启示
title_secondary: Market connectedness and price spillovers in Ghanaian maize and yam markets: Implications for food security
authors: Noah Larvoe, Muhammad Adzran Che Mustapa, Muhammad Ramzan, Edward Martey, José M. Gil 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Integrated staple food markets are essential for food security in sub-Saharan Africa, where national production is often sufficient but spatial disparities limit access for households in deficit regions. This study examines price connectedness in maize and yam markets across ten major regions in Ghana and assesses how transmission patterns respond to domestic and global shocks. Using monthly wholesale prices from January 2006 to December 2024, we employ a dynamic Quantile Vector Autoregression framework to estimate spillovers across the full distribution of price movements. The results show strong integration in maize markets, with total dynamic connectedness averaging 92 %. Major assembly and transit markets, including Kumasi, Techiman and Bolgatanga, consistently transmit price shocks, while coastal consumption markets such as Accra and Takoradi receive them. Yam markets exhibit weaker and more variable integration, with an average connectedness of 87 % and a more dispersed structure of price leadership across regions. For both commodities, connectedness strengthened during the 2008 food price hikes, whereas connectedness during the COVID-19 period was uneven and volatile. In contrast, political regime changes in 2009 and 2017 do not generate substantial shifts in market connectedness, highlighting the dominant role of structural supply chains and trader coordination over short-term political events. The findings identify regional markets where households face greater exposure to price volatility and highlight the importance of spatially targeted investments in transport, storage and market coordination alongside measures to manage shock transmission and reduce vulnerability to price volatility and unequal food access.
abstract_zh: 一体化主食市场对于撒哈拉以南非洲的粮食安全至关重要，该地区国家层面的产量往往充足，但空间差异限制了缺粮区域家庭的获取能力。本研究考察了加纳十个主要地区玉米和山药市场的价格关联性，并评估了传导模式如何响应国内及全球冲击。利用2006年1月至2024年12月的月度批发价格数据，我们采用动态分位数向量自回归框架，估计价格变动全分布上的溢出效应。结果显示，玉米市场整合程度较高，总动态关联度平均为92%。主要集散和转运市场，包括库马西、特奇曼和博尔加坦加，持续传导价格冲击，而阿克拉和塔科拉迪等沿海消费市场则接收这些冲击。山药市场表现出较弱且波动较大的整合特征，平均关联度为87%，且区域间价格领导结构更为分散。就两种商品而言，关联度在2008年食品价格飙升期间有所增强，而在COVID-19期间则呈现不均衡且波动的态势。相比之下，2009年和2017年的政治政权更迭并未引发市场关联度的显著变化，凸显了结构性供应链和交易商协调相对于短期政治事件的支配作用。研究结果识别了家庭面临更大价格波动风险的区域市场，并强调了在交通、仓储和市场协调方面进行空间定向投资的重要性，同时需采取措施管理冲击传导，以降低价格波动脆弱性和粮食获取不平等。

title: 共同富裕进程中的数字政府建设：政务服务均等化与县域经济发展的视角
title_zh: 共同富裕进程中的数字政府建设：政务服务均等化与县域经济发展的视角
title_primary: 共同富裕进程中的数字政府建设：政务服务均等化与县域经济发展的视角

title: The dire consequences of a corrupt sport contest
title_zh: 腐败体育竞赛的严重后果
title_primary: 腐败体育竞赛的严重后果
title_secondary: The dire consequences of a corrupt sport contest
authors: Anastasios Dosis, Petros G. Sekeris
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study setups where the winner of a qualifying Tullock contest can participate in a subsequent sport competition where their relative performance depends on initial efforts at the qualifying stage. If the qualifying contest is staged in favour of a team, the cheating team always sees its qualifying probability improve. The effect on investments, however, is non-monotonic: for mild levels of cheating, the higher likelihood of qualifying for the subsequent competition strengthens the cheating team’s incentives to invest, raising its effort above the unbiased benchmark; for intense levels of cheating, the near-certainty of qualifying eliminates the incentive to compete for the local prize, and the cheating team drastically cuts its investments. The rival team, on the other hand, always reduces its equilibrium effort as corruption becomes more intense. The cheating player has incentives to carry out illegal activities since his payoff increases in cheating. In such corrupt qualifiers, the champion tends to be the cheating player, and the representative from this qualifying group in the subsequent competition will perform worse if corruption is intense.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种赛制：在资格赛阶段通过Tullock竞赛胜出的队伍，可参与后续体育赛事，而该队伍在后续赛事中的相对表现取决于其在资格赛阶段的初始努力。若资格赛存在偏向某支队伍的舞弊行为，则该作弊队伍进入资格赛的概率始终会提高。然而，舞弊对投资的影响呈现非单调性：在轻度舞弊水平下，进入后续赛事概率的提升会增强作弊队伍的投资激励，使其努力水平高于无偏基准；在重度舞弊水平下，近乎确定的晋级资格消除了争夺本地奖项的激励，导致作弊队伍大幅削减投资。另一方面，随着腐败程度加剧，对手队伍始终会降低其均衡努力水平。由于作弊者的收益随舞弊程度增加而上升，其具有实施非法行为的激励。在此类腐败资格赛中，冠军往往由作弊队伍获得，且若腐败程度严重，该资格赛群体在后续赛事中的代表队伍表现将更差。

title: Moral hazard spillovers across losses
title_zh: 损失间的道德风险溢出效应
title_primary: 损失间的道德风险溢出效应
title_secondary: Moral hazard spillovers across losses
authors: Hong Li, Tao Li
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This note analyzes how the moral hazard underlying one loss spills over to another. In a competitive insurance market with two mutually exclusive losses — one is subject to moral hazard while the other is not — we demonstrate that policyholders buy only partial insurance coverage for both losses, even if the second is free of moral hazard. Moreover, the coverage for the second loss is always more generous, and numerical analysis shows that the coverage gap widens with more efficient prevention efforts or lower risk aversion. A mutual assistance mechanism that allows acquainted policyholders to share uninsured risks is introduced to alleviate moral hazard and enhance social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了某一损失所隐含的道德风险如何外溢至另一损失。在竞争性保险市场中，存在两种互斥损失——一种受道德风险影响，另一种则不受——我们证明，即使第二种损失不存在道德风险，投保人仍会仅为两种损失购买部分保险保障。此外，第二种损失的保障总是更为慷慨，数值分析显示，随着预防措施效率提高或风险厌恶程度降低，保障差距会扩大。本文引入一种互助机制，允许相识的投保人分担未保险风险，以缓解道德风险并增进社会福利。

title: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
title_zh: 面板流失、数据插补与主观不良感受的年龄模式
title_primary: 面板流失、数据插补与主观不良感受的年龄模式
title_secondary: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
authors: David G. Blanchflower, Alex Bryson, Alan J. Cui
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the implications of panel attrition for the age profile of subjective ill-being in the Global Flourishing Study (GFS). We establish that survey attrition rates are high, and are highest among the young, particularly when interviewed in wave 1 using a computer-assisted web interview (CAWI). We then deploy three methods (inverse probability weighting, multiple imputation chain equations, and last observation carried forward) to estimate the age pattern in subjective ill-being in wave 2 of the survey. All three methods have their strengths and weaknesses, but we demonstrate that such adjustments are merited given the nature of survey attrition in the data. We conclude that subjective ill-being is declining in age in both waves 1 and 2 of the GFS having accounted for sample attrition, something that would not have been apparent if one simply ran wave 2 regressions without accounting for sample attrition.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了全球繁荣研究（GFS）中面板数据流失对主观不幸福感年龄分布的影响。我们证实调查流失率较高，且年轻群体流失率最高，尤其是在第一轮采用计算机辅助网络访谈（CAWI）时。随后，我们运用三种方法（逆概率加权、多重链式方程插补及末次观测值结转法）估计第二轮调查中主观不幸福感的年龄模式。三种方法各有优劣，但研究表明，鉴于数据中调查流失的性质，此类调整是必要的。我们得出结论：在考虑样本流失后，GFS第一轮与第二轮调查中主观不幸福感均随年龄增长而下降——这一结论若仅对第二轮数据进行未考虑样本流失的回归分析将无法显现。

title: Nationality quotas and wages in professional sports: evidence from the Canadian Football League
title_zh: 国籍配额与职业体育薪资：来自加拿大橄榄球联盟的证据
title_primary: 国籍配额与职业体育薪资：来自加拿大橄榄球联盟的证据
title_secondary: Nationality quotas and wages in professional sports: evidence from the Canadian Football League
authors: Jack Badger
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines how nationality-based employment quotas affect wages using player-level data from the Canadian Football League (CFL), where teams are required to field a minimum number of Canadian players. Using salary data from 2021 to 2025, I find that Canadian players earn approximately 9–11% more than comparable American players on average. Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition shows that although American players possess stronger observable performance characteristics, Canadian players receive higher returns to these characteristics. I further validate these findings by showing that Canadian all-stars receive a premium relative to their American counterparts, especially in positions with a lower supply of domestic labour. These findings contribute to the literature on labour market regulation by illustrating how binding employment quotas shape wage determination in highly specialized and skilled labour markets. The results inform policy debates about employment protections, visa restrictions and local hiring requirements.
abstract_zh: 本文利用加拿大橄榄球联盟（CFL）的球员层面数据，考察基于国籍的就业配额如何影响工资水平，该联盟要求各队必须安排最低数量的加拿大球员上场。基于2021年至2025年的薪资数据，我发现加拿大球员平均比可比美国球员多赚约9%至11%。Oaxaca–Blinder分解显示，尽管美国球员在可观测的表现特征上更为突出，但加拿大球员在这些特征上获得了更高的回报。我进一步验证了这些发现，表明加拿大全明星球员相对于其美国同行享有溢价，尤其是在本土劳动力供给较低的职位上。这些发现为劳动力市场规制文献做出了贡献，阐明了具有约束力的就业配额如何在高度专业化和技能密集型的劳动力市场中塑造工资决定机制。研究结果对关于就业保护、签证限制及本地雇佣要求的政策辩论具有参考意义。

title: Optimal tax rates in endogenous reward mechanisms: An inverted U-shaped impact on sustaining cooperation
title_zh: 内生奖励机制中的最优税率：对维持合作的倒U型影响
title_primary: 内生奖励机制中的最优税率：对维持合作的倒U型影响
title_secondary: Optimal tax rates in endogenous reward mechanisms: An inverted U-shaped impact on sustaining cooperation
authors: Shan Jin, Xiaomeng Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Cooperation is fundamental to the functioning of societies and has been extensively examined across economics, sociology, and biology. Traditional mechanisms for sustaining cooperation, such as punishment and exogenous rewards, often entail significant drawbacks, including resource wastage and dependence on external inputs. In response to these limitations, Yang et al. (2018) introduced an endogenous reward mechanism that maintains cooperation by imposing a tax on participants and allowing them to vote on the allocation of the collected tax revenue, thereby rewarding individuals with higher cooperative tendencies. This study aims to replicate and extend Yang et al. (2018)’s findings by employing a larger sample size and exploring the effects of varying tax rates on the sustainability of cooperation. Our results confirm that the endogenous reward mechanism effectively sustains cooperation, replicating Yang et al. (2018) conclusions at the 20% tax rate. Moreover, we discovered that the maintenance of cooperation follows an inverted U-shaped relationship with the tax rate, peaking at 60%. Higher and lower tax rates were found to be less effective in sustaining cooperative behavior. These findings provide valuable insights into optimizing tax rates for promoting cooperation.
abstract_zh: 合作是社会运作的基础，已在经济学、社会学和生物学领域得到广泛研究。传统的维持合作机制，如惩罚和外部奖励，往往伴随着显著缺陷，包括资源浪费和对外部投入的依赖。针对这些局限，Yang等人（2018）提出了一种内生奖励机制，通过对参与者征税并允许他们就税收收入的分配进行投票，从而奖励合作倾向较高的个体，以此维持合作。本研究旨在通过采用更大的样本量并探索不同税率对合作可持续性的影响，来复制并扩展Yang等人（2018）的研究发现。我们的结果证实，内生奖励机制能有效维持合作，在20%的税率下复制了Yang等人（2018）的结论。此外，我们发现合作的维持与税率呈倒U型关系，在60%时达到峰值。研究发现，较高和较低的税率在维持合作行为方面效果较差。这些发现为优化税率以促进合作提供了宝贵的见解。

title: Welfare program participation among US farmworkers
title_zh: 美国农场工人福利计划参与情况
title_primary: 美国农场工人福利计划参与情况
title_secondary: Welfare program participation among US farmworkers
authors: Alexandra E. Hill, Sarah C. Whitnall, Elizabeth C.A. Saunders, Timothy K.M. Beatty
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines US farmworker participation in social safety net programs, providing the first comprehensive comparison across the National Agricultural Workers Survey, the American Community Survey, and the Current Population Survey. We measure levels, trends, and predictors of farmworker participation rates in six programs: the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC), Medicaid, Unemployment Insurance (UI), the National School Lunch and Breakfast Program (NSLP), and the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). Across surveys, we find that participation rates among income-eligible farmworker households are consistently highest for Medicaid (71%–79%) and the EITC (75%) and lowest for UI (21%). We evaluate how survey design and data collection methodologies shape these estimates through question wording, farmworker coverage, nonresponse, and measurement error. Comparing across surveys, we identify multiple persistent predictors of participation, including citizenship, gender, age, and educational attainment. These findings inform targeted outreach and policy interventions to enhance participation among US farmworkers and mitigate health and economic disparities.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了美国农场工人参与社会安全网项目的情况，首次对全国农业工人调查、美国社区调查和当前人口调查进行了全面比较。我们衡量了农场工人在六个项目中参与率的水平、趋势及预测因素：补充营养援助计划（SNAP）、妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）、医疗补助、失业保险（UI）、全国学校午餐和早餐计划（NSLP）以及劳动所得税抵免（EITC）。跨调查结果显示，在符合收入条件的农场工人家庭中，医疗补助（71%–79%）和劳动所得税抵免（75%）的参与率始终最高，而失业保险（21%）的参与率最低。我们通过问题措辞、农场工人覆盖范围、无应答和测量误差，评估了调查设计和数据收集方法如何影响这些估计值。跨调查比较后，我们识别出多个持续的参与预测因素，包括公民身份、性别、年龄和教育程度。这些发现为有针对性的外展服务和政策干预提供了信息，旨在提高美国农场工人的参与率，并缓解健康和经济差距。

title: Disaster exposure and residential solar adoption: Urban evidence from Japan
title_zh: 灾害暴露与住宅太阳能采用：来自日本城市的证据
title_primary: 灾害暴露与住宅太阳能采用：来自日本城市的证据
title_secondary: Disaster exposure and residential solar adoption: Urban evidence from Japan
authors: Jian Wang, Cheng Peng, Xiugang Zhu, Xuepeng Qian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite extensive research on solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption, limited attention has been given to the role of disaster experiences in accelerating the shift toward sustainable energy. This study investigates how earthquake events influence household solar adoption in Japan, leveraging a comprehensive panel dataset of Japanese regions. Employing a quasi-experimental design, we find that, following the disaster, household solar panel installations increase significantly more in affected areas than in unaffected regions. Our results underscore the behavioral response to disasters as a pivotal yet underexamined driver of renewable energy adoption. Additionally, we estimate the potential reductions in carbon emissions associated with this increased solar adoption. These findings offer actionable insights for policymakers aiming to design post-disaster policies that foster renewable energy adoption and enhance energy resilience.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于太阳能光伏（PV）采用的研究已相当广泛，但关于灾害经历在加速向可持续能源转型中的作用却鲜有关注。本研究利用日本各地区的综合面板数据集，探讨地震事件如何影响家庭太阳能采用情况。通过采用准实验设计，我们发现，在灾害发生后，受灾地区的家庭太阳能板安装量显著高于未受灾地区。我们的研究结果强调了灾害后的行为反应作为可再生能源采用的一个关键但尚未充分研究的驱动因素。此外，我们还估算了与这种增加的太阳能采用相关的潜在碳排放减少量。这些发现为政策制定者设计灾后政策以促进可再生能源采用并增强能源韧性提供了可行的见解。

title: Social comparison and energy conservation: the role of reference groups and room dynamics in a field experiment
title_zh: 社会比较与节能：实地实验中参照群体与房间动态的作用
title_primary: 社会比较与节能：实地实验中参照群体与房间动态的作用
title_secondary: Social comparison and energy conservation: the role of reference groups and room dynamics in a field experiment
authors: Ya‐Wen Tseng, Jie‐Yu Yang, Eric S. Lin, Yating Chuang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents a non-price-based conservation experiment performed among 6723 college dorm residents. We analyse the effectiveness of a behavioural intervention delivered through email, featuring one of two types of social-comparison-based energy consumption feedback: a quintile social comparison message and a mean comparison message. The quintile social comparison message ranks residents' relative energy consumption in quintiles, while the mean comparison message compares their consumption to the average. Our results show that the relative effectiveness of these messages depends on residents' baseline consumption patterns. Users in the higher quintiles (fourth and fifth) are more likely to reduce their energy consumption, while those in the lower quintiles (first and second) tend to increase their electricity usage after receiving the messages. We also observe that this adjustment towards the median consumption level appears to be more pronounced in single- and double-student rooms compared to multiple-student rooms. Using a causal forest approach to examine heterogeneity, we find that certain individual traits and physical factors may influence these room dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文开展了一项基于非价格手段的节能实验，研究对象为6723名大学宿舍居民。我们分析了一种通过电子邮件实施的 behavioural 干预措施的有效性，该干预包含两种基于社会比较的能耗反馈之一：五分位社会比较信息与均值比较信息。五分位社会比较信息将居民的相对能耗按五分位排名，而均值比较信息则将其能耗与平均水平进行比较。我们的结果显示，这些信息的相对有效性取决于居民的基线能耗模式。处于较高五分位（第四和第五）的用户更倾向于减少能耗，而处于较低五分位（第一和第二）的用户在收到信息后往往增加用电量。我们还观察到，这种向中位能耗水平调整的趋势在单人及双人宿舍中比在多人宿舍中更为显著。通过使用因果森林方法考察异质性，我们发现某些个体特征和物理因素可能影响这些宿舍动态。

title: How Aggregate Growing Season Temperature Metrics May Lead to Overestimation of the Effects of High Temperatures on Crop Yields: Evidence From China
title_zh: 聚合生长季温度指标如何导致高温对作物产量影响的高估：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 聚合生长季温度指标如何导致高温对作物产量影响的高估：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: How Aggregate Growing Season Temperature Metrics May Lead to Overestimation of the Effects of High Temperatures on Crop Yields: Evidence From China
authors: Kaixing Huang, Peng Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Existing studies generally use “aggregate” temperature measures—such as mean temperature, degree‐days, temperature bins, and piecewise linear functions within the growing season—to estimate the impact of global warming on crop yields. These temperature measures blend temperatures from different phenological stages of crop growth, thereby implicitly assuming that temperatures are additively substitutable within the growing season. However, this assumption contradicts agronomic knowledge, which indicates that crops are more sensitive to temperatures during certain phenological stages. Utilising unique site‐level data on the detailed phenological stages of major crops in China, combined with crop production data and daily weather data, we develop an econometric model with stage‐specific temperature measures. We then compare our estimates with models using traditional aggregate temperature measures. Our results show that adopting an aggregate temperature measure could overestimate the damage of predicted global warming on crop yields by up to two times compared to estimates using stage‐specific temperature measures.
abstract_zh: 摘要 现有研究通常采用“总体”温度指标——如生长期内的平均温度、度日、温度区间及分段线性函数——来评估全球变暖对作物产量的影响。这些温度指标混合了作物不同物候阶段的温度，从而隐含假设生长期内温度具有可加替代性。然而，这一假设与农学知识相悖，后者表明作物在特定物候阶段对温度更为敏感。利用中国主要作物详细物候阶段的独特站点级数据，结合作物生产数据和逐日天气数据，我们构建了一个包含阶段特定温度指标的计量经济模型。随后，我们将我们的估计结果与使用传统总体温度指标的模型进行比较。结果显示，与使用阶段特定温度指标的估计相比，采用总体温度指标可能将预测的全球变暖对作物产量的损害高估至多两倍。

title: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
title_zh: 期望与困惑：证据与理论
title_primary: 期望与困惑：证据与理论
title_secondary: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
authors: Heng Chen, Yicheng Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper, we characterize a forecasting model where forecasters cannot perfectly distinguish between the two persistent components (trends and cycles) in a dynamic setting. In this model, forecasters jointly update their beliefs about the two components: noisy information about one component is used to update beliefs about the other component. We present diagnostic empirical facts on forecasting behaviors and show that these facts are consistent with our model’s predictions while contradicting those of existing models in the expectation formation literature. To validate our model, we exploit the Federal Reserve’s 2012 adoption of explicit inflation targeting as a policy shock. Structural estimation reveals that this policy change altered the underlying data-generation process, and the corresponding changes in forecasting behavior indeed align with our model’s predictions. Finally, we characterize how this rational confusion mechanism interacts with behavioral biases such as overconfidence and show that this interaction can address the well-known persistent forecast error puzzle in the literature.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了一个预测模型，在该模型中，预测者无法在动态环境中完美区分两个持久性成分（趋势与周期）。在此模型中，预测者联合更新关于这两个成分的信念：关于一个成分的噪声信息被用于更新关于另一个成分的信念。我们提出了关于预测行为的诊断性经验事实，并表明这些事实与我们的模型预测一致，同时与预期形成文献中现有模型的预测相矛盾。为验证我们的模型，我们利用美联储2012年采用明确通胀目标制作为政策冲击。结构估计揭示，这一政策变化改变了潜在的数据生成过程，且相应的预测行为变化确实与我们的模型预测相符。最后，我们刻画了这一理性混淆机制如何与过度自信等行为偏差相互作用，并表明这种相互作用能够解决文献中著名的持续预测误差之谜。

title: Link or Languish? A Long‐Run Empirical Analysis of Production Network Positioning, Embeddedness and Growth
title_zh: 链接还是衰落？生产网络定位、嵌入性与增长的长期实证分析
title_primary: 链接还是衰落？生产网络定位、嵌入性与增长的长期实证分析
title_secondary: Link or Languish? A Long‐Run Empirical Analysis of Production Network Positioning, Embeddedness and Growth
authors: Davide Samuele Luzzati, Giorgio Fagiolo, Sebastiano Michele Zema
official: 官方在线 2026-05-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Production networks influence economic outcomes through several channels. On the one hand, linkages within such networks enhance productivity and have been pivotal for development. On the other hand, integration into Global Value Chains (GVCs) can drive economic upgrading. This paper provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of these mechanisms over the long run. Using a long-run multi-country input–output dataset (1965–2014), we trace the origins and evolution of global production networks (GPNs). By employing parsimonious measures of production structure (namely, upstreamness and downstreamness), we show that both national and international linkages relate to different dimensions of economic performance. Although highly correlated, the two measures exhibit distinct associations with sectoral performance. At the aggregate country level, only downstreamness remains robustly associated with growth, even after controlling for an extensive set of covariates. Finally, we show that growth is not driven by centrality in GPNs per se, but by embeddedness through its connection to the share of intermediate goods in production.
abstract_zh: 生产网络通过多种渠道影响经济成果。一方面，此类网络内部的联系提升了生产率，并对发展起到了关键作用。另一方面，融入全球价值链（GVCs）能够推动经济升级。本文对这些机制进行了长期全面的实证分析。利用一个长期多国投入产出数据集（1965-2014年），我们追溯了全球生产网络（GPNs）的起源与演变。通过采用生产结构的简约度量指标（即上游度和下游度），我们展示了国内与国际联系如何与经济绩效的不同维度相关联。尽管这两个指标高度相关，但它们与部门绩效的关联却呈现出显著差异。在国家总体层面，即使在控制了大量协变量之后，只有下游度与增长保持稳健的相关性。最后，我们指出增长并非由在全球生产网络中的中心地位本身驱动，而是通过其与生产中中间品份额的关联所体现的嵌入性所驱动。

title: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
title_zh: 玻璃箱机器学习与公司债券收益
title_primary: 玻璃箱机器学习与公司债券收益
title_secondary: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
authors: Sebastian Bell, Ali Kakhbod, Martin Lettau, Abdolreza Nazemi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Machine learning methods in asset pricing are often criticized for their black box nature. We study this issue by predicting corporate bond returns using interpretable machine learning on a high-dimensional bond characteristics data set. We achieve state-of-the-art performance while maintaining an interpretable model structure, overcoming the accuracy–interpretability trade-off. The estimation uncovers nonlinear relationships and economically meaningful interactions in bond pricing, notably related to term structure and macroeconomic uncertainty. Subsample analysis reveals stronger sensitivities to these effects for small firms and long-maturity bonds. Finally, we demonstrate how interpretable models enhance transparency in portfolio construction by providing ex ante insights into portfolio composition.
abstract_zh: 资产定价中的机器学习方法常因其“黑箱”特性而受到批评。我们通过在高维债券特征数据集上运用可解释机器学习预测公司债券回报来研究这一问题。我们在保持模型结构可解释的同时达到了最先进的性能，克服了准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。估计过程揭示了债券定价中的非线性关系及具有经济意义的交互作用，尤其涉及期限结构和宏观经济不确定性。子样本分析显示，小型企业和长期债券对这些效应的敏感性更强。最后，我们展示了可解释模型如何通过提供投资组合构成的事前洞察，增强投资组合构建的透明度。

title: Strategy-Proof social choice correspondences and single-peaked preferences
title_zh: 防策略性社会选择对应与单峰偏好
title_primary: 防策略性社会选择对应与单峰偏好
title_secondary: Strategy-Proof social choice correspondences and single-peaked preferences
authors: Carmelo Rodríguez-Álvarez
official: 官方在线 2025-10-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider strategy-proof social choice correspondences (SCCs) –mappings from preference profiles to sets of alternatives– when individuals are endowed with single-peaked preferences over alternatives. We interpret the selected sets of alternatives as the basis for lotteries that determine the final social choice, and consider that agents’ preferences over sets are consistent with Expected Utility Theory and Bayesian updating from an initial probability assessment over the full set of alternatives. We exploit the relation between SCCs and probabilistic decision schemes –mappings from preference profiles to lotteries over alternatives–, to characterize the family of SCCs that satisfy strategy-proofness and unanimity for arbitrary initial probability assessments. We extend the analysis to multi-dimensional convex spaces of alternatives under the uniform initial probability assessment.
abstract_zh: 本文考虑策略性防策略的社会选择对应（SCCs）——即从偏好分布到备选方案集合的映射——当个体对备选方案具有单峰偏好时。我们将所选的备选方案集合视为决定最终社会选择的抽签基础，并假设个体对集合的偏好与期望效用理论一致，且基于对全部备选方案的初始概率评估进行贝叶斯更新。通过利用SCCs与概率决策方案（即从偏好分布到备选方案抽签的映射）之间的关系，我们刻画了在任意初始概率评估下满足策略防策略性和一致性的SCCs族。在均匀初始概率评估假设下，我们将分析扩展至多维凸空间中的备选方案。

title: Household decision-making with inflationary environment and the Cobb-Douglas utility

authors: Hao Wang Wuqi Zhang Dongdong Liu Lin Xu Ning Wang a School of Mathematics and Statistics, Anhui Normal University, Wuhu, Anhui, Chinab Wuhu University, Wuhu, Anhui, Chinac Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Statistics 等

abstract: In this study, we investigate the optimal investment-consumption-insurance decisions faced by a wage earner operating within an inflationary environment, utilizing a continuous finite time framework. We posit that the wage earner’s preference is described by the Cobb-Douglas utility function, which incorporates a parameter that reflects the elasticity of substitution between consumption and leisure. Additionally, we assume that the financial market comprises three distinct financial assets: a risk-free bond, an index bond and a stock. To obtain closed-form solutions for optimal strategies and value function, we utilize the martingale method in conjunction with duality theory. Finally, the impact of several model parameters on optimal strategies is explored through numerical simulation utilizing predefined parameters.
abstract_zh: 本研究在连续有限时间框架下，探讨通胀环境中工薪阶层面临的最优投资-消费-保险决策问题。假设工薪阶层的偏好由柯布-道格拉斯效用函数描述，该函数包含反映消费与闲暇替代弹性的参数。同时，假定金融市场包含三种不同金融资产：无风险债券、指数债券和股票。为获得最优策略与价值函数的闭式解，我们采用鞅方法与对偶理论相结合的分析框架。最后，通过预设参数的数值模拟，探讨了若干模型参数对最优策略的影响。
